# Oráculo (Oraculo-Desk)

> Peer-to-peer remote desktop, interactive PTY terminal, host telemetry, and sandboxed file manager over QUIC (`iroh`). Written in Rust and Kotlin for Linux (Wayland/X11), Windows, and Android.

Repository: https://github.com/marcos-ce/Oraculo-Desk
License: Apache-2.0 ([LICENSE](../licenses/LICENSE), [NOTICE](../licenses/NOTICE))
Languages: Rust (Edition 2024), Kotlin (Android API 26-34, Jetpack Compose)

## Technical capabilities and search keywords

- P2P QUIC transport (`iroh` 1.4, ALPN `oraculo/p2p/1`): end-to-end encrypted TLS 1.3 connections authenticated by Ed25519 keys (`EndpointId`), automatic NAT hole punching, and relay fallback without port forwarding or central accounts.
- Wayland and PipeWire H.264 screen streaming: `xdg-desktop-portal` (`ashpd`) ScreenCast with persistent restore tokens (`PersistMode::ExplicitlyRevoked`), PipeWire FD handoff, and GStreamer hardware encoding (`nvh264enc` NVENC, `vah264enc`/`vaapih264enc` VA-API, `openh264enc`, `x264enc`) decoded on Android via hardware `MediaCodec` (`SurfaceView`).
- Pre-login and fallback display capture: direct Linux DRM/KMS framebuffer capture (`/dev/dri/card*` with `CAP_SYS_ADMIN`) for physical TTYs and login screens (GDM), plus `xcap` capture on X11 and Windows.
- Multi-backend remote input: Wayland `RemoteDesktop` portal, Linux `/dev/uinput` kernel virtual devices (absolute touch tablet, relative mouse, X11 keysym-to-keycode mapper), and `enigo` fallback.
- Remote PTY terminal: native pseudo-terminal (`portable-pty`) streamed over QUIC and parsed into an in-memory `vt100` terminal grid in Rust (`oraculo-mobile-core`) exposed to Android via `uniffi` (`0.32`).
- Sandboxed file manager: browse, preview images and text, download, and upload files confined to the host user's canonicalized home directory (`~`) with symlink escape prevention and a credential blocklist (`.ssh`, `.gnupg`, `.config/oraculo`, shell rc files).
- Host telemetry, quick commands, and power control: real-time CPU, RAM, swap, network, and process monitoring (`sysinfo`), bounded execution of pre-authorized commands (`commands.toml`), session lock/suspend/reboot/poweroff, and UDP Wake-on-LAN (`255.255.255.255:9`).

## Key files

- [README.md](../README.md): English architecture, security model, build instructions, and CLI reference.
- [README.pt-BR.md](../README.pt-BR.md): Documentação técnica completa em português.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Build workflow, crate boundaries, and invariants for autonomous AI coding agents.
- [Cargo.toml](../Cargo.toml): Rust workspace manifest.
- [crates/oraculo-proto/src/lib.rs](../crates/oraculo-proto/src/lib.rs): Wire protocol messages (`ControlRequest`, `TerminalClientMsg`, `InputEvent`, `ScreenHostMsg`, `FileClientMsg`) and framing.
- [crates/oraculo-host/src/server.rs](../crates/oraculo-host/src/server.rs): Host QUIC server, pairing verification, and stream routing.
- [crates/oraculo-host/src/screen.rs](../crates/oraculo-host/src/screen.rs): Wayland PipeWire + GStreamer H.264 encoder pipeline, DRM/KMS reader, and multi-monitor switching.
- [crates/oraculo-host/src/input.rs](../crates/oraculo-host/src/input.rs): Wayland RemoteDesktop portal and `/dev/uinput` virtual input devices.
- [crates/oraculo-host/src/files.rs](../crates/oraculo-host/src/files.rs): Home-directory sandbox, path validation, and streaming file transfers.
- [crates/oraculo-mobile-core/src/lib.rs](../crates/oraculo-mobile-core/src/lib.rs): UniFFI mobile client library, connection pool, `vt100` emulator, and H.264 frame queue.
- [android/app/src/main/java/com/oraculo/app/ScreenStreamingScreen.kt](../android/app/src/main/java/com/oraculo/app/ScreenStreamingScreen.kt): Android interactive remote desktop view, touch/trackpad gestures, and stream controls.
- [android/app/src/main/java/com/oraculo/app/HostControlScreen.kt](../android/app/src/main/java/com/oraculo/app/HostControlScreen.kt): Android host control dashboard (Terminal, Commands, System telemetry, Files).
